name: plan
description: Create a step-by-step plan for complex tasks. Use this BEFORE executing tools when a task has multiple steps, involves unfamiliar code, or requires coordination across files/systems. Each step should specify what to do, why, and which tool to use. `delegate: true` implies `parallelizable: true` (delegation is inherently async). Simple tasks (read one file, answer a question, run one command) do NOT need a plan - just act directly.

action.description: What to do in this step (e.g., 'read src/main.rs', 'run cargo build', 'apply patch to fix X').

reason.description: Why this step is needed and what we expect to learn or achieve.

tool.description: Primary tool for this step (e.g. 'read_file', 'execute_command', 'apply_patch', 'knowledge_search'). Use 'none' if no tool is needed.

parallelizable.description: Whether this step can run in parallel with the previous step (no data dependency). Default: false.

delegate.description: Whether this step should be delegated to a subagent. `delegate: true` implies `parallelizable: true` (a subagent should not block the parent synchronously); set `parallelizable` explicitly only when true without delegation. Multiple independent delegated steps run concurrently; a lone delegated step runs synchronously.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to accomplish the task.

summary.description: Brief one-line summary of the overall plan.
